purpose: Fail-closed source/runtime contract for the six generated benchmark trees. It corrects discontinuous segmented woody radii and exact bark-UV restarts without awarding Visual Fidelity points. Native 3840x2160 rendered evidence remains authoritative.

loadPath: visible root flare and radial surface roots broaden the trunk into grade rather than entering soil as a telephone-pole cylinder
trunk radius decreases continuously through the seven generated trunk sections
primary branch A tapers into primary branch B without a reverse radius jump
secondary branches and twigs remain subordinate in diameter to their parents
foliage remains attached to twig tips and is evaluated separately by the foliage optical-physicality contract
biologicalConstruction.orientationExposure: Outdoor deciduous park trees in a midsummer Japanese new-town scene. Trunk/branch surfaces receive direct sun, sky fill, occlusion at unions and ordinary dry-weather exposure; no disaster, impact or reconstruction cues are permitted.
biologicalConstruction.groundInterface: The root flare remains visible at grade. Existing cause-based maintained tree-pit/understory logic remains authoritative for the surrounding soil/paving interface.

allowed: slightly darker sheltered crotches only when produced by lighting/occlusion

sourceAudit.legacyTreeSegmentUv: GM_Tree* woody meshes used normalized 0..1 UVs per segment and a shared PBR_Bark tiling value, causing every trunk/branch segment to restart the same bark phase.
sourceAudit.risk: At native 4K, repeated bark phase plus 10-40 mm reverse radius steps can read as modular pipe sections rather than a continuous living trunk and can trigger obvious repeated-module/geometry deductions.

rootFlares.note: Root flare visibility is biologically intentional; do not hide the trunk base below the soil surface.

geometryVsMaterialDetail.forbiddenShortcut: Do not paint geometry seams, branch collars, contact shadows or highlights into albedo.

material.name: PBR_Bark
material.microstructure: Longitudinal/fissured bark breakup; macro silhouette stays geometric while sub-centimeter relief stays in the normal map.
material.uvAging: Ordinary exposed-surface fading may be subtle and low-frequency only; current dry benchmark does not add a wet/dark coating.
material.angularFresnel: Dielectric Fresnel only. Grazing response may brighten through the BRDF but must never resemble polished metal or painted/baked edge highlights.

textureMapping.mode: metric cylindrical UV along each woody segment with continuity through trunk and primary A/B chains

lodPolicy.invariant: Corrected trunk/branch taper and bark UV mapping must persist through every LOD proxy that retains that woody segment; LODs may remove smaller biological tiers but may not reintroduce legacy normalized-UV or stock primitive woody geometry.

hardFailRules: any generated fallback tree retains a stock Cube/Cylinder/Sphere/Capsule renderer as visible woody art
trunk joint center gap exceeds 2 mm
trunk joint radius mismatch exceeds 2 mm
trunk radius reverses/increases materially toward the crown
primary branch A/B joint center or radius mismatch exceeds 2 mm
trunk UV V restarts at an internal section joint instead of remaining continuous
fewer than five distinct bark start phases are present across the six generated trees
albedo/normal/metallic-smoothness texture scales are not synchronized
bark metallic exceeds 0.02 or emission is enabled
root flare is buried/raised outside the contracted grade envelope
a retained LOD proxy uses a different legacy mesh from its corrected source segment
source checks are represented as rendered Visual Fidelity evidence

views: oblique/vegetation_grounding 3840x2160 source plus 100% crop: root flare, grade contact, trunk taper and bark phase
grazing/tree_shadow_contact 3840x2160 source plus 100% crop: branch unions, bark roughness/Fresnel and contact shadow
hero full frame: natural silhouette and absence of obvious cloned bark modules
temporal prepared evidence: LOD transition continuity and bark/leaf shimmer

visualCreditPolicy.note: This contract can improve Implementation Readiness and reduce known source risk only. It cannot self-award Vegetation, Geometry, Texture or Material/PBR points.
